verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe durable timers (sleep/schedule/wait for external events) and note that on FaaS platforms like Lambda the handler is suspended while sleeping to free up resources, meaning no server/connection/compute is held during long waits. Combined with durable execution guarantees (state persisted, resumable after failure) and support for human approvals/webhooks spanning long timeframes, this covers the core story well. Missing for 10: explicit independent/hands-on validation of multi-month sleep durations and billing behavior at scale.
